_provenance.notes: Genetic Stock Identification (GSI) uses DNA SNP (Single Nucleotide Polymorphism) and microsatellite markers to assign individual salmon to their birth population. This is critical for understanding the stock composition of mixed-stock fisheries (e.g., what percentage of Bristol Bay sockeye come from each district's rivers). The Pacific Salmon Commission's GSI program provides the most comprehensive baseline database for North Pacific salmon.
